observations: Brown tufted 2-seater sofa with button tufting on the backrest and armrests.
The sofa has a contrasting light-colored base frame and four decorative white-painted legs.
The upholstery appears to be a soft fabric, possibly velvet or microfiber, with a slight sheen.
The armrests are adorned with a row of small, round metallic studs.
The seat cushions are intact and appear to be in good condition.
The sofa is positioned in a tiled room with a dark patterned rug.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DESMOND DESMOND' is visible on both photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show a clean exterior, but the interior cushions and the condition of the fabric are not visible.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The sofa may have hidden stains, tears, or odors in the hidden crevices of the fabric.
risks.proof: A photo of the sofa with the backrest and seat cushions fully removed and the interior inspected.
risks.if_unproven: as having significant hidden stains or wear

risks.risk: The foam may be compressed or worn down in the cushions, even if the exterior looks good.
risks.proof: A video showing a hand pressing on the seat cushion to test the firmness.
risks.if_unproven: as having worn or compressed foam

risks.risk: The upholstery fabric may be scratchy or have a poor weave that is not visible from the front.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the fabric surface with the backrest and seat cushions removed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a rough or low-quality fabric

proof_requests: Photo of the sofa with the backrest and seat cushions removed to inspect the interior for stains and wear.
Photo of the underside of the sofa to check for wear on the base frame.
Video of someone pressing on the seat cushion to check the firmness of the foam.
Close-up photo of the fabric weave to check for scratches or poor quality.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 2-seater sofa from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case value (scratched fabric, worn foam, and hidden stains) until further proof is provided.
